command: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_conduction_2d.py -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml=/tmp/sph_center.xml
reference: Initially uniform unit slab, unit diffusivity. Opposing prescribed wall temperature changes reach +1 and -1 K at 0.04 s. Analytic continuum endpoint and time-mean profiles use the polynomial wall lift and 256 even sine modes. Max errors are over all particle centers. The cumulative midplane heat is minus the spatial derivative of the time-integrated continuum temperature at x=1/2 for unit conductivity. The west-half energy balance compares net section heat to stored energy for unit volumetric heat capacity.
